name: Rythu Bharosa
description: Investment support scheme for Telangana farmers who own cultivable agricultural land. Provides direct cash support per acre to help with seeds, fertilisers and other crop investments, paid through Direct Benefit Transfer.
benefits: Rs 12,000 per acre of cultivable land per year, paid directly to the farmer's bank account.
requiredDocuments: Bank account passbook linked to Aadhaar
applicationSteps: Ensure your land is recorded in the Dharani land records portal
Verify your Pattadar passbook details at the local Agriculture Extension Office (AEO)
Confirm your bank account is seeded with Aadhaar for Direct Benefit Transfer

rules.humanText: Applicant must own cultivable agricultural land

name: Indiramma Atmeeya Bharosa
description: Financial assistance for landless agricultural labourer families in Telangana who do not own cultivable land but depend on farm work for their livelihood.
benefits: Rs 12,000 per year per landless agricultural labourer family.
requiredDocuments: Ration card / proof of being a landless labourer family
Bank account passbook linked to Aadhaar
applicationSteps: Register as a landless agricultural labourer family at the local Gram Panchayat
Submit Aadhaar and family details for verification
Link your bank account with Aadhaar for Direct Benefit Transfer

rules.humanText: Applicant must be an agricultural labourer
Applicant must be landless (own no cultivable agricultural land)

name: Aasara Old Age Pension
description: Monthly social security pension for elderly citizens in Telangana from poor families, to provide income support in old age.
benefits: Rs 2,016 per month paid directly to the beneficiary's bank account.
requiredDocuments: White ration card / proof of low income
applicationSteps: Apply through your nearest MeeSeva centre or Gram Panchayat
Submit Aadhaar, age proof and ration card
Await field verification by the local welfare officer

rules.humanText: Applicant must be 57 years or older
Applicant must belong to a Below Poverty Line (white ration card) family

name: Aasara Widow Pension
description: Monthly pension support for widowed women in Telangana from poor families, to provide financial security.
benefits: Rs 2,016 per month paid directly to the beneficiary's bank account.
requiredDocuments: White ration card / proof of low income
applicationSteps: Apply through your nearest MeeSeva centre or Gram Panchayat
Submit Aadhaar, death certificate and ration card
Await field verification by the local welfare officer

rules.humanText: Applicant must be 18 years or older
Applicant must belong to a Below Poverty Line (white ration card) family

name: Kalyana Lakshmi / Shaadi Mubarak
description: One-time financial assistance for the marriage of unmarried women from economically weaker families in Telangana, to reduce the financial burden of marriage. Kalyana Lakshmi is for SC/ST/other eligible categories and Shaadi Mubarak for minority communities.
benefits: One-time financial assistance of Rs 1,00,116 to the bride's family.
requiredDocuments: Age proof showing bride is 18 or older
applicationSteps: Apply online on the Kalyana Lakshmi / Shaadi Mubarak portal
Upload Aadhaar, income and age proof documents
Submit through the Tahsildar for verification

rules.humanText: Bride must be at least 18 years old at the time of marriage
Family annual income must be Rs 2,00,000 or less

name: ePASS Post-Matric Scholarship
description: Post-matriculation scholarship and tuition fee reimbursement for students from SC, ST, BC, EBC, minority and disabled categories in Telangana pursuing higher education after Class 10.
benefits: Tuition fee reimbursement plus maintenance allowance for eligible students.
applicationSteps: Register on the Telangana ePASS portal
Fill the scholarship application with course and college details
Upload income and caste certificates
Submit for college and department verification

rules.humanText: Applicant must be a student in higher education
Applicant must belong to SC/ST/BC/EBC/Minority category
Family annual income must be within the prescribed limit (around Rs 2,00,000)

name: Rajiv Aarogyasri Health Scheme
description: Cashless health insurance scheme for Below Poverty Line families in Telangana, covering treatment and surgeries for serious illnesses at empanelled hospitals.
benefits: Cashless treatment coverage up to Rs 5,00,000 per family per year for listed procedures at empanelled hospitals.
requiredDocuments: Referral from a Primary Health Centre or empanelled hospital
applicationSteps: Visit an empanelled hospital with your Aarogyasri / white ration card
Get the Aarogyasri Mitra to register your case
Treatment is approved and provided cashless for listed procedures

rules.humanText: Family must hold a white ration card (Below Poverty Line)

name: Indiramma Indlu (Housing)
description: Housing assistance scheme providing financial support to eligible poor families in Telangana who do not own a pucca house, to build their own home.
benefits: Financial assistance of up to Rs 5,00,000 to construct a house for eligible beneficiaries.
requiredDocuments: White ration card / proof of low income
Proof that the family does not own a pucca house
applicationSteps: Apply through the Gram Panchayat or designated housing portal
Submit Aadhaar and ration card for verification
Await beneficiary selection and sanction order

rules.humanText: Family must be Below Poverty Line (white ration card)
Family annual income must be within the prescribed limit
